description: Individual entries for six named beasts of the Abyss.

entries.title: The Abyssal Maw
entries.summary: A shapeless black mass opens into an obsidian-toothed mouth large enough to consume an airship whole.
body: The Maw waits almost motionless in the deepest darkness before stretching to impossible size. An invisible gravity well draws ships into its reach while its presence corrodes machinery, magic, weapons, and hull systems.
Once swallowed, a vessel is immediately attacked by powerful digestive acids and may leave no recoverable trace.

sections.heading: Legacy Creature Abilities
body: Swallow Whole, Void Pull, and Abyssal Corruption require mechanical conversion.

entries.title: Shadowwing Leviathan
entries.summary: A vast dark-glass-winged serpent hunts airships through freezing gales, deafening cries, and near-invisibility.
body: Its wings span hundreds of feet and its pitch-black body blends into the Abyss. A Dark Gale can drive ships from course or tear them apart, while the Void Screech disorients crews before an ambush.
The Leviathan moves at extraordinary speed through shadow and often remains undetected until a vessel has already lost control.

sections.heading: Legacy Creature Abilities
body: Dark Gale, Void Screech, and Abyssal Flight require conversion.

entries.title: Sable Tendrils
entries.summary: Regenerating black tendrils reach from unseen depths to crush, poison, and drag ships downward.
body: Each elastic vine ends in a hungry mouth and can extend across enormous distances. Their venom paralyzes living victims and can disable exposed ship systems.
Severed portions remain dangerous, and the entire organism can regrow while any tendril survives.

sections.heading: Legacy Creature Abilities
body: Grasp of the Abyss, Poisonous Kiss, and Regeneration require conversion.

entries.title: The Blackclaw
entries.summary: A building-sized Abyssal arachnid traps vessels in energy-draining webs before tearing through metal with its claws.
body: Six bladed legs carry its armored black body with surprising speed. Ethereal silk immobilizes crews and ships while draining power from anything caught within it.
Green eyes may be the only warning before a leap. Its venom causes paralysis, hallucinations, and rapid death without treatment.

sections.heading: Legacy Creature Abilities
body: Web of the Void, Claws of Fate, and Abyssal Poison require conversion.

entries.title: Nightmare Hound
entries.summary: A light-devouring hunter pursues prey between the material sky and the Abyss while attacking mind and soul.
body: Only red eyes and a mist-wreathed jaw readily reveal the creature. Its howl projects hallucination, madness, confusion, and panic across great distances.
Once it selects prey, it phases closer repeatedly. Its bite consumes vitality from the soul and can prevent natural recovery as the victim decays.

sections.heading: Legacy Creature Abilities
body: Howl of the Void, Phantasmal Pursuit, and Soul Devour require conversion.

entries.title: Gloomrider
entries.summary: A winged humanoid hunter rides a shadow steed, vanishes into darkness, and marks victims with cursed arrows.
body: Elongated limbs, gray skin, red eyes, and a twisted humanlike face make the rider recognizable at close range. Its steed charges through the sky trailing dark energy capable of throwing vessels from course.
The Gloomrider stalks invisibly and kills with deliberate precision. Untreated arrow curses produce sickness, confusion, and eventual death.

sections.heading: Legacy Creature Abilities
body: Shadow Cloak, Cursed Arrow, and Dark Steed's Charge require conversion.
